events.title: DD Q1 Earnings Beat on Productivity Gains, Sales Rise Y/Y
events.body: DuPont beats Q1 estimates as productivity gains lift profits and sales rise, with stronger healthcare and aerospace demand driving growth.

events.title: ATI Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Robust Demand, Revenues Miss
events.body: ATI beats Q1 EPS on strong aerospace and defense demand, but revenues miss estimates as pricing and product mix lift profitability.

events.title: Kinross Gold Q1 Earnings and Sales Beat on Higher Gold Prices
events.body: KGC's Q1 profit surgesd on soaring gold prices, with earnings and revenue topping estimates despite weaker output and rising costs.

events.title: Agnico Eagle's Q1 Earnings and Sales Beat on Higher Gold Prices
events.body: AEM tops Q1 estimates as earnings and revenues soar, driven by higher gold prices, even as costs rise and production dips.
